{"language":"python","code":"from pathlib import Path
import re, subprocess
page = Path('website_museum_openai-gpt-5.6-terra_01.html')
html = page.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
match = re.search(r'<script>([\s\S]*?)</script>', html, re.I)
if not match:
    raise SystemExit('Inline script not found')
check = Path('.refio-artifact-check.js')
check.write_text(match.group(1), encoding='utf-8')
try:
    result = subprocess.run(['node', '--check', str(check)], text=True, capture_output=True)
    if result.returncode:
        raise SystemExit(result.stderr or result.stdout)
    print('Inline JavaScript syntax: valid')
finally:
    check.unlink(missing_ok=True)"}
